channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: CBS is going to solve all our journalism problems
item.description: A media critic dismantles CBS's glossy rebrand under Tony Dokoupil, arguing its five “promises” mask corporate power, civic ignorance and a drift toward oligarchy in U.S. journalism.

item.title: Building damaged after car ignites inside
item.description: Accidental car fire inside Wilson garage damages building and machinery, causes $26K in losses; no injuries reported.

item.title: Will Trump’s residential investment ban really make homes more affordable?
item.description: Trump’s proposed ban on big investors buying single-family homes would barely dent prices, could push up rents and may mainly benefit multifamily landlords — including his own Trump Organization.

item.title: The big picture in Republican-majority Raleigh
item.description: North Carolina’s long-dominant GOP faces mounting strains as Phil Berger confronts a serious primary, tax-cut politics hit fiscal limits and a savvier Democratic minority tests Republican control.

item.title: Property tax merits reform, not repeal
item.description: As NC lawmakers weigh changes to a surging property tax system, a fiscal conservative argues the levy should be reformed and broadened, not scrapped, to fund local services fairly.

item.title: Police charge Wilson man with child abuse
item.description: Wilson man charged with felony child abuse and kidnapping after police say he abused and confined his girlfriend’s 8- and 4-year-old daughters; held without bond.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 13-14, 2026
item.description: Packed Jan. 13-14 area sports slate: full schedule of high school hoops, wrestling, winter track and Barton-Francis Marion college basketball matchups across the region.

item.title: MEET THE WARBIRDS: Front Office Edition
item.description: Front office spotlight on Account Executive Dyson Beck of Zebulon, a Carolina Hurricanes fan who loves hibachi, Christmas, and dreams of teleportation.

item.title: Ham, Lievense among George Whitfield 2026 honorees
item.description: Retired Barton coach Ron Lievense and veteran sports writer Tom Ham are among more than two dozen honorees at George Whitfield’s 53rd Baseball Clinic in Goldsboro.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Demons down SE Raleigh in 252/919 Winter Classic
item.description: Daquavis Greene’s 23-point double-double powered Fike past Southeast Raleigh in the 252/919 Winter Classic, while Justin Bridgers hit 1,000 career points and SouthWest Edgecombe boys and girls extended win streaks.
